verdict.rationale: Atlassian publishes the Jira Cloud platform REST API as a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.1 document (433 paths), linked from the REST v3 reference intro, with a vendor-generated Postman collection alongside it. The probe's 404s at generic root paths do not contradict this, because the spec lives at a product-specific path. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the spec downloads and works with tooling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
